description: Android CLI tool for project creation, builds, SDK management, and device interaction.

next.name: completion
tip: Installs shell autocomplete configuration for the Android CLI in the current user profile

next.name: create
tip: Create a new Android project from available templates. Allows specifying project name, output directory, minSdk, and dry-run execution

option.name: --application-id
tip: The application ID for the application (e.g. com.example.myapp)

option.name: --list
tip: List all available templates

option.name: --min-sdk
tip: The 'minSdk' supported by the application (default is defined in the template)

option.name: --name
tip: The name of the application (e.g. My Application)

option.name: --namespace
tip: The namespace for resources and package name for Kotlin source files

option.name: --output
tip: The destination project directory path (default is .)

next.name: describe
tip: Analyzes an Android project to generate descriptive metadata. This command identifies and outputs the paths to JSON files that detail the project structure, including build targets and their corresponding output artifact locations (e.g., APKs). This information enables other tools and commands to locate build artifacts efficiently

option.name: --project_dir
tip: The project directory to describe

next.name: docs
tip: Android documentation commands for searching and fetching developer documentation from the official knowledge base

next.name: fetch
tip: Fetch an Android documentation article from a URL (kb://...)

next.name: emulator
tip: Manage Android Virtual Devices (AVDs). Includes commands to start, stop, list, and view details about emulators

next.name: create
tip: Creates a virtual device

next.name: list
tip: Lists available virtual devices

next.name: remove
tip: Delete a virtual device

next.name: start
tip: Launches the specified virtual device. This command will return when the emulator is fully started and ready to use

next.name: help
tip: Shows the help of all commands

next.name: init
tip: Initializes the environment for the Android CLI. Sets up required configurations, directories, and default skills

next.name: install
tip: Install an Android Application (one or more APKs) to a connected device or emulator without activating any components using incremental optimizations for faster deployment than adb

option.name: --apks
tip: The paths to the APKs, comma separated

option.name: --device
tip: The device serial number

option.name: --install-options
tip: Additional options/flags to pass to package manager install (e.g. -g,-d)

option.name: --use-delta-install
tip: Use fast delta install (speeds up incremental updates by transferring only modified code and resources; default: true)

next.name: layout
tip: Returns the layout tree of an application

option.name: --device
tip: The device serial number

option.name: --diff
tip: Deprecated; no-op flag. Will be removed in a future release

option.name: --flat
tip: Returns a flat list instead of a tree

option.name: --full
tip: Return the full tree, including non-interactive and hidden elements

option.name: --no-idle
tip: Don't wait for layout idle state when fetching layout

option.name: --output
tip: Writes the layout to the specified file or directory. If omitted, prints to standard output

option.name: --pretty
tip: Pretty-prints the returned JSON

next.name: run
tip: Build, deploy, and launch an Android application on a connected device or emulator

option.name: --activity
tip: The activity name

option.name: --apks
tip: The paths to the APKs, comma separated

option.name: --debug
tip: Run in debug mode

option.name: --device
tip: The device serial number

option.name: --install-options
tip: Additional options/flags to pass to package manager install (e.g. -g,-d)

option.name: --type
tip: The component type

next.name: ACTIVITY
tip: An activity

next.name: COMPLICATION
tip: A complication

next.name: DECLARATIVE_WATCH_FACE
tip: A declarative watch face

next.name: TILE
tip: A tile

next.name: WATCH_FACE
tip: A watch face

next.name: WEAR_WIDGET
tip: A wear widget

option.name: --use-delta-install
tip: Use fast delta install (speeds up incremental updates by transferring only modified code and resources; default: true)

next.name: screen
tip: Commands to view the device

next.name: capture
tip: Outputs the device screen to a PNG

next.name: resolve
tip: Target UI elements visually. Substitutes bounding box coordinates from an annotated screenshot into a string. Replaces all instances of a given text in the screenshot with the coordinates of the element

next.name: sdk
tip: Manage the Android SDK installation. Includes commands to install, update, remove, and list available and installed SDK packages

option.name: --ignore-outdated-xmls
tip: When installing or updating packages, do not update other packages xmls

option.name: --platform
tip: Target platform <os>_<arch> (e.g. linux_x86_64, mac_arm64, windows_x86), defaults to current host

next.name: install
tip: Install SDK packages

next.name: list
tip: List installed and available SDK packages

next.name: remove
tip: Remove packages from the SDK

next.name: skills
tip: Manage Android CLI skills. Includes commands to install, remove, list, and search for skills by keyword

next.name: add
tip: Install a specific skill by its ID to your environment

next.name: find
tip: Search for available skills in the repository matching a keyword

next.name: list
tip: List installed and available skills

next.name: remove
tip: Remove an installed skill by its ID

tip: Android Studio commands

tip: Analyze a file in Android Studio

tip: Check the status of running Studio instances

tip: Find usages of a symbol

next.name: open-file
tip: Open a file in Android Studio

tip: Render a Compose preview in Android Studio

tip: The URL to download the update from

tip: Path to the Android SDK
